light_description: Mini-sized transparent-style overdrive with clean-boost through fuzzy-distortion range via mode switching; hand-wired and hand-painted.
Mini-sized silicon Fuzz Face-style fuzz; official documentation identifies NOS Hitachi 2SC281 transistors and a hand-wired/hand-painted build.
Wide-range overdrive inspired by Plexi-era Marshall; shares a discrete circuit platform with Yellow Brick but has different part values and voicing.
Wide-range overdrive inspired by Tweed Fender; lower-gain/darker companion to Red Brick on a shared discrete platform.
British-style germanium fuzz using selected NOS germanium transistors; official page provides exterior product images and build description.
Bass overdrive derived from Red Brick, with SVT-inspired voicing and a shared discrete platform with Silver Brick.
Bass overdrive derived from Red Brick, with 1970s Fender Bassman-inspired voicing and reduced low-end/drive versus Black Brick.
Big Muff-family fuzz explicitly presented by KAMINARI as an ACE TONE FM-3 recreation; hand-wired and hand-painted.
2026 fuzz recreation targeting the early Triangle-era Big Muff sound; part of the Newport Muff family.
2026 fuzz recreation targeting the 1973 violet Big Muff; part of the Newport Muff family.
2026 fuzz recreation targeting a later Ram's Head-era Big Muff; part of the Newport Muff family.
Transparent/Klon-style overdrive with separated gain/blend controls and selectable buffered or true bypass; hand-wired and hand-painted.
Clean booster designed to raise volume without changing tone or distortion amount; excluded from central dirt catalog.
